newsitem.title: USA: Applied Materials sees Q2 revs of $875 mln.
newsitem.headline: Applied Materials sees Q2 revs of $875 mln.

text.p: Applied Materials Inc Chief Financial Officer Gerald Taylor said Tuesday he expects the company's fiscal second quarter revenues to rise to $875 million from $836 million in the just-completed fiscal first quarter.

Speaking to analysts on a conference call, Taylor said he expects second quarter earnings per share of $0.48. In the year-ago quarter, Applied Materials earned $186 million or $1.01 a share on sales of $1.13 billion.
Applied Materials executives told analysts the company has a much better story to tell this quarter and they believe the company has experienced the bottom of its revenue cycle.
For the year, Taylor expects revenues to total about $3.6 billion and earnings per share to be between $2.10 and $2.20, prior to the first quarter charge of $0.32 a share.
In 1996, Applied Materials earned $599.6 million or $3.27 a share on sales of $4.14 billion. According to First call, analysts expect the company to report a fiscal 1997 profit of $1.85 a share.
